name: easy-screen-recorder
title_zh: 按一下就开始录屏，录完直接给你 MP4 文件
tagline_zh: 不想为了录一段演示去装 OBS、调编码器、配场景。点开就录，停止即出片，轻到几乎不占内存。
tagline_en: Skip OBS setup, scene configs and encoder tuning. Open, hit record, stop, and you already have a shareable MP4.
why_zh: 把「录制」压缩成一个按钮：没有场景、没有推流面板、没有编码参数，装完就能用。
why_en: Recording is reduced to a single button: no scenes, no streaming panel, no encoder knobs. Install, record, get a plain MP4.
limit_zh: 只做全屏或窗口的整段录制，没有区域框选、没有摄像头画中画、没有剪辑和时间轴；录完就是最终文件，想剪掉开头几秒得另找工具。
limit_en: Full-screen or window capture only: no region select, no webcam overlay, no timeline editing. The file you get is final; trimming needs another tool.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: One-click screen recorder that hands you an MP4
